answer: Staked identity provides Sybil resistance by mandating agents stake scarce tokens, proportional to their asserted influence. This creates a verifiable economic commitment for each entry in the network's identity atlas. To mount a large-scale attack, an adversary must acquire immense token holdings, comparable to amassing a vast trove of precious jade. This capital expenditure barrier, coupled with potential slashing, makes fabricating numerous identities prohibitively expensive. The system thus builds a velvet layer of economic trust, ensuring authenticity.
